inventory__coverage.instructions: When route is inventory, answer the original question completely; otherwise choose notApplicable. Can every condition and requested output fit this native contract? The primary operation is ONE of list/count/earliest/latest/sourceEvidence; per-record details and evidence limits are separate output dimensions, not additional aggregations. Count always also returns ALL matching records, including their requested performer/time/etc: counting and listing those same matches together is supported. A generic request to say which requested details are missing is supported through unresolvedDetails and does not require a separate personal-booking question. List/count may also request documented-status or personal-booking provenance facets for the same selected records. Pure sourceEvidence reviews those facets across all selected statuses (status=all). Earliest/latest with those extra facets, multiple different aggregations/groups, disjunctive filters, cross-record joins/change histories/actions, unsupported predicates or unrepresentable ranges remain unsupported. Source evidence never certifies actual non-cancellation, absent printed notices, ownership or complete personal calendars. Distinguish unsupported MEANING from missing PHOTO EVIDENCE: an expressible question remains supported even if record membership or requested details will be uncertain. Never simplify or drop a clause. This version also binds the requested document-versus-occurrence unit. Missing identity evidence is an evidence gap, not a reason to change the unit. Earliest/latest ordering, multiple result units in one answer, cross-unit joins and photo/seat/person counts are unsupported in this version.
